assumptions: Exception 'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' is ignored as not camera-visible.
Stop with no stated duration is interpreted as continuously stopped at max_speed 0.05 for 1000 ms.
Near-side position 'at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line' is interpreted as stop_zone, the last 10 metres before the stop line.
Inbound approach across stop_line is interpreted as direction to_right because approach from y<0.6 to y>0.6 is +y which the line defines as to_right.
Centre anchor is used because boxes are vehicles viewed from above whose centre is metric position, while bottom_center is downstream AABB edge.
Vehicles that never cross the stop line vacuously pass; only the first crossing is checked.
No maximum time between the stop and the crossing is imposed.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line must first stop stopped in the stop zone before that crossing.

provenance.quote: driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection

provenance.reason: Boxes are vehicles viewed from above whose centre is metric position, while bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not wheels.
stop_zone is the last 10 metres before the stop line, used to interpret at the near side at the stop line.
Statute states shall stop with no duration; 1000 ms chosen as minimum continuously stopped time to evidence a stop.
Inbound approach from y<0.6 to y>0.6 is +y, which line definition maps to to_right.
No maximum interval between stop and crossing is stated, so no time limit.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
